summary: Recently, improvements were made to the way audio and video elements work in Firefox by implementing a **new loading attribute** that allows developers to specify how media files should be loaded, helping optimize performance and user experience. Additionally, changes to the _muted_ content attribute mean that when a video or audio is set to be muted, this will now be accurately reflected in the browser's native media controls, ensuring better consistency in playback behavior. Together, these updates enhance how media content is handled, offering a smoother experience for both developers and users.
